title: Card kholo, jaldi!
format: Kitty Gang unboxing on the Shaadi Ka Card game: the gang opens a wedding card one layer at a time, each layer is one prize group, and the last layer flips it

experiment.hook: Tanya waving a sealed envelope on the Shaadi Ka Card home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'SHAADI KA CARD AAYA!' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Shaadi ka card aaya! Kholo jaldi!'
experiment.variable: an unboxing structure built on a ritual every viewer did this wedding season: opening a shaadi card layer by layer (date, kaju dabba, 'sahparivar?', lifafa), one reveal per cut matched to the theme's four prize groups (Card, Kaju Dabba, Mehmaan, Lifafa), so each cut answers a small question and opens the next
experiment.hypothesis: opening a real wedding card in peak shaadi season is the 'moment people are living now' that earned our only share (festival-moment 10-29), and a reveal every 2 s keeps the middle: skip under 58% (best experiment 57.1), watched % above 22 (best 21), at least 1 share or tag from 'jiska card aaya hai'

idea: Tanya gets a shaadi card and the gang opens it together: Ruhi checks the date, Megha grabs the kaju dabba, Myra hunts for her name under 'sahparivar', Shruti fixes the lifafa at 101; then Aditi reads the last line: it is the invite to tonight's Shaadi Ka Card Housie, so Tanya calls for lehengas.
beats: hook: card aaya, kholo / call: 19 / 1/4 Card: Ruhi date / 2/4 Kaju Dabba: Megha / 3/4 Mehmaan: Myra sahparivar / 4/4 Lifafa: Shruti 101 / turn: Aditi, Housie ka card hai / button: Tanya, lehenga nikaalo
caption: Shaadi ka card aate hi pehle kya dekhte ho: date, kaju dabba ya apna naam? Us saheli ko tag karo jiska card aaj aaya. Aaj {theme} Housie, lehenga ready rakho!

lines.text: Shaadi ka card aaya! Kholo jaldi!
lines.say: शादी का कार्ड आया! खोलो जल्दी!

lines.text: Date dekho! Sunday hai, chhutti pakki.
lines.say: डेट देखो! संडे है, छुट्टी पक्की।

lines.text: Kaju katli! Calories shaadi ke baad.
lines.say: काजू कतली! कैलोरीज़ शादी के बाद।

lines.text: Sahparivar? Mera naam bhi likha hai?
lines.say: सपरिवार? मेरा नाम भी लिखा है?
लिफ़ाफ़े में एक सौ एक। राउंड ऑफ़ नहीं।

lines.text: Hmm. Yeh Housie ka card hai.
lines.say: हम्म। यह हाउज़ी का कार्ड है।

lines.text: Toh lehenga nikaalo! Aaj Housie shaadi!
lines.say: तो लहंगा निकालो! आज हाउज़ी शादी!
